title: 新朋友
body:
你好！我是李明。今天我去公园，看见一个男孩。他说："你好，我是王朋。"我们成为朋友。天气很热，王朋给我一瓶水。我说："谢谢！"我们坐在树下喝水、聊天，很开心。

中午，王朋说："我们去吃面条吧！"我们一起去小店。我吃牛肉面条，他吃鸡蛋面条。吃完后，王朋说："谢谢你来。"我说："你是我的朋友，不用谢！"我们约好明天再见。
translation: Hello! I am Li Ming. Today I went to the park and saw a boy. He said, "Hello, I am Wang Peng." We became friends. The weather was very hot, and Wang Peng gave me a bottle of water. I said, "Thank you!" We sat under a tree drinking water and chatting, very happy.

At noon, Wang Peng said, "Let's go eat noodles!" We went to a small shop together. I ate beef noodles, and he ate egg noodles. After eating, Wang Peng said, "Thank you for coming." I said, "You are my friend, no need to thank me!" We made an appointment to meet again tomorrow.

title: 我的朋友
body:
你好！我是小明。我有一个朋友，他叫大卫。大卫今天来我家，我很高兴。我想请他吃东西，可是我家没有水，也没有茶。大卫说：“没关系，我不喝水。”我很感谢我的朋友。

大卫喜欢吃面，所以我请他吃面。他说：“谢谢，这面很好吃！”我们一边吃一边说话，真开心。吃完以后，大卫说：“明天你来我家，我请你喝水。”我说：“好，明天见！”
translation: Hello! I am Xiaoming. I have a friend, his name is David. David came to my house today, I am very happy. I wanted to treat him to food, but my house had no water and no tea either. David said: "It's okay, I don't drink water." I am very grateful to my friend.

David likes to eat noodles, so I treated him to noodles. He said: "Thank you, these noodles are delicious!" We ate while talking, truly happy. After finishing eating, David said: "Tomorrow you come to my house, I will treat you to water." I said: "Okay, see you tomorrow!"

title: 一次特别的旅行
body:
小王一直想学习摄影，但一直没有机会。去年夏天，他的朋友小李建议他去云南旅行，说那里的环境非常美丽，很适合拍照。小王觉得这个建议很好，于是决定买一台相机，开始准备这次特别的旅行。

到了云南以后，小王发现那里的山和水真的很漂亮。他每天早起去拍日出，晚上和朋友讨论怎么拍出更好的照片。小李有很多摄影经验，教小王怎么找最好的光线。虽然小王有时候拍不好，但他从不放弃，每天都学到新东西。

旅行结束后，小王拍了很多好看的照片。这次经历让他明白，只要有机会就要勇敢尝试。他感谢小李的建议，也感谢自己做的决定。现在小王越来越喜欢摄影，他希望以后可以去更多地方，用相机记录美丽的环境。
translation: Xiao Wang had always wanted to learn photography, but never had the opportunity. Last summer, his friend Xiao Li suggested he travel to Yunnan, saying the environment there was very beautiful and perfect for taking photos. Xiao Wang thought this was a good suggestion, so he decided to buy a camera and began preparing for this special trip.

After arriving in Yunnan, Xiao Wang discovered that the mountains and waters there were truly beautiful. He got up early every day to shoot the sunrise, and in the evenings discussed with his friend how to take better photos. Xiao Li had a lot of photography experience and taught Xiao Wang how to find the best lighting. Although Xiao Wang sometimes didn't take good photos, he never gave up and learned something new every day.

After the trip ended, Xiao Wang had taken many beautiful photos. This experience made him understand that whenever there's an opportunity, you should bravely try. He thanked Xiao Li for the suggestion and also thanked himself for the decision he made. Now Xiao Wang likes photography more and more, and he hopes to go to more places in the future to record beautiful environments with his camera.

title: 去农村工作的决定
body:
李明在城市里工作已经五年了，但他觉得自己的生活缺少意义。有一天，他看到一个广告，说农村需要老师，他立刻觉得这是一个很好的机会。虽然他没有教学经验，但他决定试一试。

李明到了农村以后，发现这里的环境和城市很不一样。空气很新鲜，人们也很友好。他和校长讨论了自己的想法，校长给了他很多有用的建议。每天早上，他骑自行车去上课，学生们都很喜欢他。通过教学，他学到了很多经验，也明白了帮助别人的快乐。

一年后，李明必须做出一个重要的决定：回城市还是留在农村？他想起这一年的生活，想起学生们的笑脸，最后他决定留下来。现在，他每天都过得很开心，他知道自己的选择是对的。
translation: Li Ming had worked in the city for five years, but he felt his life lacked meaning. One day, he saw an advertisement saying that rural areas needed teachers, and he immediately felt this was a great opportunity. Although he had no teaching experience, he decided to give it a try.

After Li Ming arrived in the countryside, he discovered that the environment here was very different from the city. The air was fresh, and the people were very friendly. He discussed his ideas with the principal, who gave him many useful suggestions. Every morning, he rode his bicycle to class, and the students all liked him very much. Through teaching, he learned a lot of experience and also understood the joy of helping others.

After a year, Li Ming had to make an important decision: return to the city or stay in the countryside? He thought about this year of life, remembered the smiles of his students, and finally decided to stay. Now, he lives happily every day, and he knows his choice was the right one.

title: 新的工作机会
body:
小李在一家小公司工作了三年，虽然有很多经验，但是工作环境不太好，每天都很累。有一天，他的朋友小王给他打电话，说有一家大公司正在找人，建议他去试试看。小李觉得这是一个很好的机会，可是他又有点害怕，不知道应不应该换工作。

那天晚上，小李和家人一起讨论这个问题。妈妈说：“你应该勇敢一点，不要害怕改变。”爸爸也说：“我同意你妈妈的建议，新的环境可能会让你更开心。”听了家人的话，小李决定接受这个挑战，去大公司面试。

一个月后，小李成功地得到了新工作。新的环境真的很好，同事们也很友好。他非常感谢小王的建议，也感谢家人的支持。这次经历让他明白，有时候做一个重要的决定很难，但是只要有机会，就应该勇敢地去尝试。
translation: Xiao Li had worked at a small company for three years. Although he had a lot of experience, the work environment was not good, and he was tired every day. One day, his friend Xiao Wang called him and said a large company was hiring, suggesting he give it a try. Xiao Li thought this was a great opportunity, but he was also a little afraid, unsure whether he should change jobs.

That evening, Xiao Li discussed this problem with his family. His mother said, "You should be braver and not be afraid of change." His father also said, "I agree with your mother's suggestion; the new environment might make you happier." After hearing his family's words, Xiao Li decided to accept this challenge and go to the interview at the large company.

One month later, Xiao Li successfully got the new job. The new environment was really good, and his colleagues were very friendly. He was very grateful for Xiao Wang's suggestion and also thanked his family for their support. This experience made him understand that sometimes making an important decision is difficult, but as long as there is an opportunity, one should bravely try.

title: 并购风云
body:
林氏集团的会议室里，空气仿佛凝固了。陈总监放下手中的文件，目光扫过对面的谈判代表："贵公司的报价远低于我们的预期，这场谈判恐怕很难继续。"对方代表张经理微微一笑，从公文包中取出一份市场分析报告："我们仔细研究了林氏的潜力，贵公司在新能源领域的技术储备确实令人印象深刻，但目前的财务状况让我们不得不谨慎。"

陈总监陷入沉思。他深知，若拒绝这次合作，公司可能面临资金链断裂的风险；可若轻易妥协，多年的心血将被低价收购。他起身走到窗前，俯瞰着城市的灯火，脑海中不断权衡着各种可能性。窗外的霓虹闪烁，像极了此刻他心中交错的利弊得失。

"我们需要一个新的战略。"陈总监转过身，语气坚定，"不是单纯的买卖，而是深度合作。我们可以成立合资公司，林氏出技术，贵方出资金，共享未来的收益。"张经理挑了挑眉，显然没料到这一转折。两人重新落座，气氛渐渐从对峙转向探讨。

经过数小时的拉锯，双方终于达成共识。签字的那一刻，陈总监感到一种复杂的释然——这不是完美的胜利，却是当下最明智的选择。他明白，商业世界少有绝对的输赢，懂得在关键时刻妥协与调整，才是真正的智慧。
translation: In the conference room of Lin Group, the air seemed to freeze. Director Chen put down the documents and glanced at the negotiators across from him: 'Your offer is far below our expectations; I'm afraid this negotiation will be difficult to continue.' The other party's representative, Manager Zhang, smiled slightly and took out a market analysis report from his briefcase: 'We have carefully studied Lin's potential. Your company's technical reserves in the new energy field are indeed impressive, but the current financial situation forces us to be cautious.'

Director Chen fell into deep thought. He knew well that if he rejected this cooperation, the company might face the risk of capital chain rupture; yet if he compromised easily, years of hard work would be acquired at a low price. He stood up and walked to the window, overlooking the city lights, constantly weighing various possibilities in his mind. The neon lights flickering outside were much like the intertwined pros and cons in his heart at this moment.

'We need a new strategy.' Director Chen turned around, his tone firm. 'Not a simple buyout, but deep cooperation. We can establish a joint venture—Lin contributes technology, your side contributes capital, and we share future profits.' Manager Zhang raised an eyebrow, clearly not expecting this turn of events. The two sat down again, and the atmosphere gradually shifted from confrontation to discussion.

After several hours of back-and-forth, both sides finally reached consensus. At the moment of signing, Director Chen felt a complex sense of relief—this was not a perfect victory, but it was the wisest choice under the circumstances. He understood that in the business world, there is rarely absolute winning or losing; knowing when to compromise and adjust is true wisdom.

title: 并购风云
body:
晨曦透过落地窗洒进会议室，林总监凝视着对面的竞争对手，心中早已拟定好完整的战略。这场关于两家科技公司的合并谈判已持续三个月，双方都清楚彼此的潜力——一家拥有核心技术，另一家掌握市场渠道。然而，股权分配的分歧让谈判屡次陷入僵局。

"我们需要权衡短期利益与长期发展，"林总监放下咖啡杯，语气沉稳，"若执着于控股权，只会两败俱伤。"对方代表冷笑："妥协意味着软弱，我们绝不会让步。"会议室的空气骤然凝固，助理紧张地记录着每一句话。

深夜的酒店房间里，林总监独自复盘。他意识到真正的战略不是击败对手，而是找到共赢之道。次日清晨，他提出创新方案：设立双层股权结构，既保障原团队的话语权，又引入新资本激活潜力。这个提议打破了谈判的坚冰。

最终协议签署时，双方代表相视而笑。林总监明白，商业世界从无绝对的胜负，唯有懂得妥协与权衡的人，才能驾驭复杂的博弈。窗外城市灯火璀璨，新的征程即将开启。
translation: Morning light streamed through the floor-to-ceiling windows into the conference room. Director Lin gazed at his competitor across the table, having already formulated a complete strategy in his mind. The merger negotiations between the two tech companies had lasted three months; both sides understood each other's potential—one possessed core technology, the other controlled market channels. Yet disagreements over equity distribution had repeatedly deadlocked the talks.

"We need to weigh short-term interests against long-term development," Director Lin set down his coffee cup, his tone steady. "If we obsess over controlling stakes, both sides will lose." The opposing representative sneered: "Compromise means weakness. We will never back down." The air in the conference room suddenly froze; the assistant nervously recorded every word.

In the hotel room late at night, Director Lin reviewed the situation alone. He realized that true strategy lay not in defeating opponents but in finding win-win solutions. The next morning, he proposed an innovative plan: establish a dual-class share structure that would both protect the original team's voice and attract new capital to unlock potential. This proposal broke the ice in the negotiations.

When the final agreement was signed, representatives from both sides smiled at each other. Director Lin understood that in the business world, there was never absolute victory or defeat—only those who understood compromise and weighing trade-offs could navigate complex games. Outside the window, the city lights glittered brilliantly; a new journey was about to begin.

title: 两家公司的合并
body:
李明是一家科技公司的年轻总监，最近公司面临被收购的危机。董事会上，他冷静地分析道："我们必须制定一个长远的战略，不能只看眼前的利益。"他深知这家老牌企业虽然规模不大，却蕴藏着巨大的潜力，尤其在人工智能领域拥有核心技术。

收购方的代表张总亲自来到会议室，谈判从上午持续到深夜。双方在股权分配问题上僵持不下，气氛一度十分紧张。李明意识到，如果完全拒绝对方的要求，公司可能失去这次发展的机会；但如果轻易让步，创始团队将失去话语权。他在心里仔细权衡着各种可能性，汗水悄悄浸湿了衬衫。

凌晨两点，李明终于提出一个方案：创始团队保留百分之三十的股权，同时获得未来三年的独立运营权。张总沉默良久，最终点了点头。这个妥协让双方都保住了最核心的利益，也为合作奠定了基础。签字时，李明的手微微颤抖，却露出了释然的微笑。

三个月后，合并后的新公司上市，股价首日大涨。庆功宴上，张总举杯对李明说："年轻人，你的战略眼光让我佩服。"李明回应道："真正的成功，不在于谁赢了谈判，而在于找到彼此都能接受的平衡点。"窗外灯火璀璨，他知道，这次经历将成为职业生涯中最宝贵的财富。
translation: Li Ming was a young director at a technology company, which recently faced the crisis of being acquired. At the board meeting, he calmly analyzed: "We must formulate a long-term strategy and not just look at immediate interests." He knew well that although this established company was not large in scale, it possessed tremendous potential, especially in the field of artificial intelligence where it held core technologies.

Representative Zhang from the acquiring party came to the conference room in person, and the negotiations lasted from morning until late at night. The two sides were deadlocked over the issue of equity distribution, and the atmosphere became extremely tense at one point. Li Ming realized that if they completely rejected the other party's demands, the company might lose this opportunity for development; but if they gave in easily, the founding team would lose their voice. He carefully weighed various possibilities in his mind, sweat quietly soaking through his shirt.

At two o'clock in the morning, Li Ming finally proposed a plan: the founding team would retain thirty percent of the equity while obtaining independent operating rights for the next three years. President Zhang remained silent for a long time before finally nodding. This compromise allowed both sides to preserve their core interests and also laid the foundation for cooperation. When signing, Li Ming's hands trembled slightly, yet he showed a relieved smile.

Three months later, the merged new company went public, and its stock price surged on the first day. At the celebration banquet, President Zhang raised his glass and said to Li Ming: "Young man, your strategic vision impresses me." Li Ming responded: "True success lies not in who won the negotiation, but in finding a balance that both sides can accept." Outside the window, the lights were splendid; he knew that this experience would become the most valuable asset in his career.

title: 小李的周末
body:
小李在银行工作已经三年了。虽然他的工资不错，但是工作压力很重，每天都很累。这个周末，他决定去乡下看望奶奶。奶奶住在山里，路很长，但空气很好。小李想，这次一定要好好休息一下，把烦恼都还给别人。

到了奶奶家，他发现院子里的苹果树长高了。奶奶笑着说：“你上次来的时候，树还很小，现在已经长大了。”小李帮奶奶浇了水，然后一起去菜园摘菜。奶奶做的菜味道差了一点，因为她年纪大了，但是他还是吃得很开心。晚上，奶奶又重讲了一遍她年轻时的故事，小李听得入了迷。

星期天下午，小李必须回城了。奶奶给他装了一大袋苹果，说：“这些苹果不重，你带回去吃吧。”小李知道奶奶是差人送来的，其实心里很不舍。他抱了抱奶奶，说：“下个月我还来看您。”然后带着满满的爱，踏上了回家的路。
translation: Xiao Li has been working at a bank for three years. Although his salary is decent, his work pressure is very heavy, and he is tired every day. This weekend, he decided to visit his grandmother in the countryside. His grandmother lives in the mountains; the road is long, but the air is fresh. Xiao Li thought, this time he must rest well and return his worries to others.

Arriving at his grandmother's house, he found that the apple tree in the yard had grown taller. His grandmother smiled and said, 'When you came last time, the tree was still small, but now it has grown up.' Xiao Li helped his grandmother water the plants, and then they went to the vegetable garden to pick vegetables together. The food his grandmother made tasted a bit poor because she is old now, but he still ate happily. In the evening, his grandmother repeated the story of her youth once more, and Xiao Li listened, completely captivated.

Sunday afternoon, Xiao Li had to return to the city. His grandmother packed him a big bag of apples and said, 'These apples are not heavy, take them back and eat.' Xiao Li knew his grandmother was dispatching him with reluctance in her heart. He hugged his grandmother and said, 'I'll come see you again next month.' Then, carrying full love, he set off on the journey home.

His colleagues all tease him, saying he looks like an artist. Xiao Li smiles and says, 'Once this month's tasks are finished, I will definitely go get a haircut.'

Yesterday, the bank dispatched Xiao Li on a business trip to another city. He brought a very heavy suitcase full of documents. The train was crowded, and Xiao Li found his seat taken. He had to stand, thinking to himself, 'I hope nothing goes wrong with this business trip.' When he arrived at the hotel, he discovered he had also forgotten his charger, and his phone was almost out of battery.

This morning, Xiao Li finally finished his work. He returned to the bank and gave the documents back to the manager. The manager checked them once and said with a smile, 'No mistakes, well done! You can go home and rest early today.' Xiao Li was extremely happy and decided that tomorrow he must definitely get a haircut and then sleep well.

老王打开箱子一看，里面全是旧衣服和书，没有一分钱。他耐心地解释说这里不能存这些东西，只能存钱。老太太的脸色变得很差，开始重复地说："我孙子答应过我的！"原来她孙子去外地出差了，很久没回来，她想念他，才想出了这个办法。

老王心软了，他帮老太太把箱子里的东西整理好，还给她孙子打了电话。孙子听说后很感动，第二天就坐火车回来了。老太太终于笑了，她说银行的人真好。老王看着祖孙俩离开，觉得这份工作虽然有时候很累，但能帮助别人，真的很值得。

Lao Wang opened the box and saw it was full of old clothes and books, not a single coin. He patiently explained that they couldn't deposit these things here, only money. The old lady's face looked very poor, and she began to repeat, 'My grandson promised me!' It turned out her grandson had been dispatched to work in another city and hadn't returned for a long time; she missed him and had come up with this idea.

Lao Wang's heart softened. He helped the old lady organize the things in the box and called her grandson. The grandson was very moved when he heard this and took the train back the next day. The old lady finally smiled and said the bank people were so kind. Lao Wang watched the grandmother and grandson leave, feeling that although this job was sometimes tiring, being able to help others made it truly worthwhile.

title: 雨后的邂逅
body:
去年夏天，我在云南旅行时，经历了一次难忘的邂逅。那天下午突然下起大雨，我躲进一家小茶馆，浑身都被水打湿了。茶馆里坐着一位老人，他微笑着递给我一杯热茶，我们就这样成了朋友。

老人告诉我，他年轻时也曾踌躇不前，不知道该不该离开家乡去外面看看。他站在村口整整三天，最后终于鼓起勇气走了出去。他说，人生最怕的就是犹豫，机会往往就在踌躇的瞬间溜走。他的故事让我深受触动。

离别时，老人送我一瓶山泉水，说：「朋友，记住，别让犹豫挡住你的路。」我把那瓶水带回家，放在书桌上。每当面对选择时，我都会想起那次邂逅，然后坚定地迈出脚步。
translation: Last summer, while traveling in Yunnan, I experienced an unforgettable chance encounter. That afternoon, it suddenly started raining heavily, and I took shelter in a small teahouse, completely soaked by water. An old man was sitting inside; he smiled and handed me a cup of hot tea, and just like that, we became friends.

The old man told me that when he was young, he too had hesitated, unsure whether he should leave his hometown to see the world. He stood at the village entrance for three whole days before finally mustering the courage to leave. He said that what people fear most in life is hesitation, and opportunities often slip away in those moments of indecision. His story deeply moved me.

When we parted, the old man gave me a bottle of mountain spring water and said, 'Friend, remember, don't let hesitation block your path.' I brought that bottle of water home and placed it on my desk. Whenever I face choices, I think of that chance encounter, and then I take a firm step forward.

title: 雨中的邂逅
body:
去年夏天，我在云南旅行时，于丽江古城的小巷里与一位老朋友不期而遇。那天下着细雨，石板路湿漉漉的，空气中弥漫着淡淡的茶香。我正站在一家茶馆门口踌躇，不知道该不该进去避雨，忽然听见身后有人叫我的名字。回头一看，竟是我大学时的室友小林！

我们相视而笑，仿佛时光从未流逝。小林拉着我的手走进茶馆，点了一壶普洱。她告诉我，她已经在丽江住了三年，每天画画、喝茶、散步，过着简单的生活。我惊讶于她的改变，记忆中的她总是忙碌而焦虑，如今却如此从容。窗外的雨渐渐停了，阳光透过云层洒下来，水面上的倒影闪闪发光。

临别时，小林送我一幅她画的古城风景。她说："人生就像这场雨，你永远不知道会遇见谁，但每一次邂逅都有它的意义。"我握紧她的手，心中充满温暖。回到酒店，我把画挂在墙上，泡了一杯茶，静静地看着窗外的夜色。那杯水倒映着灯光，就像那个下午一样明亮。
translation: Last summer, while traveling in Yunnan, I had a chance encounter with an old friend in the alleyways of Lijiang Ancient Town. It was drizzling that day, the stone slabs were wet, and the air was filled with a faint tea fragrance. I was hesitating at the entrance of a teahouse, unsure whether to go in to escape the rain, when suddenly I heard someone call my name from behind. I turned around and saw that it was my college roommate, Xiaolin!

We smiled at each other as if time had never passed. Xiaolin took my hand and led me into the teahouse, ordering a pot of Pu'er tea. She told me she had been living in Lijiang for three years, spending her days painting, drinking tea, and taking walks, living a simple life. I was surprised by her transformation; in my memory, she had always been busy and anxious, but now she was so calm. The rain outside gradually stopped, and sunlight shone through the clouds, making the reflections on the water sparkle.

When we parted, Xiaolin gave me a painting she had made of the ancient town. She said, "Life is like this rain—you never know who you'll meet, but every encounter has its meaning." I held her hand tightly, my heart full of warmth. Back at the hotel, I hung the painting on the wall, brewed a cup of tea, and quietly gazed at the night outside. The water in my cup reflected the lamplight, as bright as that afternoon.

title: 延误的航班
body:
去年夏天，我们全家计划去云南旅行。爸爸提前三个月就预订了机票和酒店，妈妈说这次旅行一定要控制好预算，不能太浪费。我和妹妹都很期待，听说那里的风景特别美，还有很多有趣的纪念品可以买。

出发那天早上，天气突然变得很差。大雨一直下个不停，我们担心地看了看窗外。爸爸安慰我们说："没关系，飞机一般不会受天气影响。"我们拖着沉重的行李， hurriedly 赶到了机场。

到了机场，我们发现航班信息屏幕上显示我们的航班延误了。工作人员解释说，因为天气原因，所有航班都要推迟起飞。我们只好在机场等待区坐下来，开始漫长的等待。

妈妈从包里拿出护照检查了一遍，确认没有问题。她叹了口气说："我们的导游还在目的地等着呢，不知道他会不会着急。"爸爸给导游打了电话，告诉他我们会晚到几个小时。

等待的时间过得特别慢。妹妹饿了，我们就去机场餐厅吃了午饭。虽然价格比外面贵很多，但是为了省钱，我们还是控制在预算之内。爸爸笑着说："旅行中总会有意外，重要的是一家人在一起。"

下午三点，天气终于好转了。机场广播通知我们的航班可以登机了，大家都松了一口气。我们拿好行李，快步走向登机口。虽然延误了五个小时，但我们终于能出发了。

到达云南的时候，天已经黑了。导游热情地接待了我们，还帮我们安排了附近的酒店。他说："虽然你们今天没能看到风景，但是明天我会带你们去最美的地方。"我们感激地向他道谢。

第二天一早，阳光明媚，天气好极了。导游带我们去了丽江古城，那里的风景真的美得像画一样。我们拍了很多照片，还买了一些当地的纪念品送给朋友。虽然第一天的延误让我们有些疲惫，但是看到这么美的景色，一切都值得了。

这次旅行让我明白，计划永远赶不上变化。即使遇到延误这样的麻烦，只要保持好心情，旅行依然可以很美好。我们一家人在一起的时光，比任何风景都更加珍贵。
translation: Last summer, our whole family planned to travel to Yunnan. Dad booked the flights and hotel three months in advance, and Mom said we had to control the budget this time and not waste too much money. My sister and I were both very excited, having heard that the scenery there was especially beautiful and that there were many interesting souvenirs to buy.

On the morning of our departure, the weather suddenly became very bad. Heavy rain kept falling nonstop, and we looked out the window with worry. Dad comforted us, saying, "Don't worry, planes usually aren't affected by weather." We dragged our heavy luggage and hurried to the airport.

When we arrived at the airport, we discovered that our flight was showing as delayed on the flight information screen. Staff explained that due to weather conditions, all flights would be postponed. We had no choice but to sit down in the airport waiting area and begin our long wait.

Mom took out her passport from her bag and checked it to confirm everything was in order. She sighed and said, "Our tour guide is still waiting at the destination, I wonder if he'll be worried." Dad called the tour guide and told him we would arrive several hours late.

The waiting time passed especially slowly. My sister was hungry, so we went to eat lunch at an airport restaurant. Although the prices were much higher than outside, to save money we still kept it within our budget. Dad smiled and said, "There are always surprises when traveling; what matters is that our family is together."

At three in the afternoon, the weather finally improved. The airport announcement notified us that our flight could board, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief. We gathered our luggage and walked quickly to the boarding gate. Although we were delayed by five hours, we could finally depart.

When we arrived in Yunnan, it was already dark. The tour guide received us warmly and even helped arrange a nearby hotel for us. He said, "Although you couldn't see the scenery today, tomorrow I'll take you to the most beautiful places." We thanked him gratefully.

Early the next morning, the sun was shining and the weather was wonderful. The tour guide took us to Lijiang Old Town, where the scenery was truly as beautiful as a painting. We took many photos and also bought some local souvenirs to give to friends. Although the first day's delay made us somewhat tired, seeing such beautiful scenery made everything worthwhile.

This trip taught me that plans can never keep up with changes. Even when encountering troubles like delays, as long as you maintain a good mood, travel can still be wonderful. The time our family spent together was more precious than any scenery.

我们提前三个小时到达了机场，办理登机手续的时候，工作人员微笑着告诉我们航班可能会延误。原来，目的地那边突然下起了大雨，天气状况不适合飞机降落。听到这个消息，弟弟差点哭了出来，他盼这次旅行已经盼了很久。爸爸安慰他说没关系，延误只是暂时的，我们一定能出发。

等待的时间里，我们在机场餐厅吃了午饭。虽然食物比外面贵一些，但还在预算之内。妈妈趁机打开了旅行手册，给我们介绍云南的风景。她说那里有美丽的雪山、清澈的湖泊，还有古老的城镇。我们请了一位导游，她会在我们到达后带我们参观。我想象着那些美丽的风景，心情慢慢好了起来。

三个小时过去了，航班仍然没有确切的起飞时间。机场广播里不断播放着延误通知，越来越多的乘客开始不耐烦。有些人去找工作人员理论，有些人则在椅子上睡着了。我决定去机场的商店逛逛，看看有什么纪念品可以买。我发现了一些很有特色的手工艺品，虽然价格不便宜，但我想用省下来的饭钱买一件送给好朋友。

终于，在等了六个小时之后，我们收到了好消息。天气好转了，飞机可以起飞了！大家欢呼起来，纷纷拿起行李冲向登机口。妈妈松了一口气，赶紧给预订的酒店打电话，告诉他们我们会晚到，请保留房间。导游也发来消息，说她会在机场等我们，不管多晚都会来。

到达云南的时候，已经是深夜了。虽然比计划晚了整整一天，但我们都很兴奋。导游是一位热情的年轻女士，她举着牌子在出口等我们。她告诉我们，因为延误，明天早上的行程需要调整，但主要景点都不会错过。我们坐上车，看着窗外的夜景，虽然看不见白天的风景，但路灯下的街道也很有味道。

第二天一早，太阳刚刚升起，我们就出发了。导游带我们去了最著名的古城，那里的建筑保存得很好，街道两旁都是卖纪念品的小店。我用昨天剩下的钱买了一件手工刺绣的包，妈妈说我眼光不错。爸爸拍了很多照片，他说要把这些美丽的风景都记录下来。弟弟则对当地的小吃最感兴趣，他吃了三大碗米线。

这次旅行虽然开头不太顺利，但我们全家都觉得很难忘。延误让我们学会了耐心和随机应变，也让我们更加珍惜在一起的时光。回家的路上，妈妈说她已经开始计划下一次旅行了，不过下次她会多留一天作为备用时间。我们都笑了起来，期待着下一次的冒险。
translation: Last summer, our whole family decided to travel to Yunnan. Mom started planning this trip three months in advance, carefully arranging every day's itinerary, and also booking hotels and plane tickets. Dad said the budget for this trip was ten thousand yuan, and we should try to save money but also have fun. My younger brother and I were both very excited, because this was the first time our whole family was going somewhere so far away together.

On the morning of our departure, the weather was especially nice, with bright sunshine and not a single cloud in the blue sky. We packed our luggage early, each person bringing one large suitcase and a small backpack. Mom repeatedly checked our passports, afraid she might forget something important. She said passports were the most important thing, and without them we couldn't go abroad, although this was just a domestic trip, she had developed this good habit.

We arrived at the airport three hours early. When checking in, the staff member smiled and told us that our flight might be delayed. It turned out that sudden heavy rain had started at our destination, and the weather conditions were not suitable for landing. Hearing this news, my younger brother almost cried, as he had been looking forward to this trip for so long. Dad comforted him, saying it was okay, delays were only temporary, and we would definitely be able to depart.

During the waiting time, we had lunch at the airport restaurant. Although the food was more expensive than outside, it was still within budget. Mom took this opportunity to open the travel guide and introduce Yunnan's scenery to us. She said there were beautiful snow mountains, clear lakes, and ancient towns there. We had hired a tour guide who would show us around after we arrived. I imagined those beautiful scenes and gradually felt better.

Three hours passed, and the flight still had no definite departure time. The airport broadcast kept playing delay announcements, and more and more passengers were becoming impatient. Some people went to argue with staff, while others fell asleep in their chairs. I decided to browse the airport shops to see what souvenirs I could buy. I found some very distinctive handicrafts. Although not cheap, I wanted to use my saved meal money to buy one for my good friend.

Finally, after waiting six hours, we received good news. The weather had improved, and the plane could take off! Everyone cheered, grabbing their luggage and rushing to the boarding gate. Mom breathed a sigh of relief and quickly called the booked hotel to tell them we would arrive late and to please hold our room. The tour guide also sent a message saying she would wait for us at the airport, no matter how late.

When we arrived in Yunnan, it was already late at night. Although we were a whole day behind schedule, we were all very excited. The tour guide was an enthusiastic young woman holding a sign at the exit waiting for us. She told us that because of the delay, tomorrow morning's itinerary needed adjustment, but we wouldn't miss the main attractions. We got in the car and looked at the night scenery outside the window. Although we couldn't see the daytime scenery, the streets under the streetlights also had their own charm.

Early the next morning, just as the sun was rising, we set off. The tour guide took us to the most famous ancient town, where the buildings were well preserved, and both sides of the streets were lined with small shops selling souvenirs. I used my remaining money from yesterday to buy a handmade embroidered bag, and Mom said I had good taste. Dad took many photos, saying he wanted to record all these beautiful scenes. My younger brother was most interested in the local snacks, eating three large bowls of rice noodles.

Although this trip didn't start smoothly, our whole family found it unforgettable. The delay taught us patience and adaptability, and also made us treasure our time together even more. On the way home, Mom said she was already planning the next trip, though next time she would leave an extra day as backup time. We all laughed, looking forward to our next adventure.

title: 航班延误的一天
body:
去年夏天，我们一家人决定去云南旅行。妈妈提前两个月就开始做计划，她希望这次旅行既省钱又能看到最美的风景。爸爸负责控制预算，他说不能超过八千元。我兴奋得睡不着觉，每天都在想那里的山水有多漂亮。

出发那天早上，天气突然变得很差。窗外下着大雨，风也很大。妈妈担心地说："这样的天气，飞机会不会延误啊？"爸爸安慰她："别担心，夏天的雨来得快去得也快。"我们按时把行李装上车，开车去了机场。

到了机场，大厅里已经有很多人在排队。我们找到航空公司的柜台，工作人员微笑着说："各位乘客，由于天气原因，飞往昆明的航班延误四个小时，请大家耐心等待。"听到这个消息，妈妈叹了口气，计划被打乱了。

爸爸赶紧打电话给我们的导游，告诉他我们会晚到。那位导游很理解，说："没关系，安全第一。我会帮你们调整明天的行程。"我们只好在机场的餐厅吃午饭，一边吃一边聊天，倒也不算太无聊。

等待的时候，我去书店逛了逛，想买几本关于云南风景的画册。妈妈则在纪念品商店看丝巾，她说要送给外婆。爸爸一直看着手机上的天气预报，希望雨能快点停。四个小时真的很长，我的腿都坐麻了。

终于，广播里传来好消息："各位乘客，航班现在开始登机。"我们立刻拿起行李，快步走向登机口。妈妈检查了三遍护照，生怕忘带了。爸爸笑着说："你早上已经检查过五遍了，放心！"

飞机起飞后，我透过窗户看到下面的云海，像棉花一样白。虽然延误了很久，但空中的风景真美。妈妈靠在我肩上睡着了，她为了这次旅行准备得太累了。爸爸在看杂志，偶尔拍拍我的手。

到达昆明时，天已经黑了。导游举着牌子在出口等我们，他帮我们把行李搬上车。去酒店的路上，他介绍说明天要去的古城很有名，那里的纪念品又便宜又有特色。我高兴极了，完全忘记了延误的不愉快。

这次旅行让我明白，计划永远赶不上变化。虽然航班延误了，但我们一家人在一起，说说笑笑，也是一种特别的经历。后来我们买了很多漂亮的纪念品，拍了很多照片，预算也控制得很好。这真是一次难忘的旅行。
translation: Last summer, our family decided to travel to Yunnan. Mom started making plans two months in advance, hoping this trip would be economical yet allow us to see the most beautiful scenery. Dad was in charge of controlling the budget, saying it must not exceed eight thousand yuan. I was so excited I couldn't sleep, thinking every day about how beautiful the mountains and waters there would be.

On the morning of departure, the weather suddenly became very bad. It was raining heavily outside, and the wind was strong too. Mom said worriedly, 'With this kind of weather, will the plane be delayed?' Dad comforted her, 'Don't worry, summer rain comes quickly and leaves quickly.' We loaded the luggage into the car on time and drove to the airport.

Arriving at the airport, the hall was already crowded with people lining up. We found the airline counter, and the staff member said with a smile, 'Dear passengers, due to weather conditions, the flight to Kunming is delayed by four hours. Please wait patiently.' Hearing this news, Mom sighed, as our plans were disrupted.

Dad quickly called our tour guide to tell him we would arrive late. The guide was very understanding and said, 'No problem, safety first. I will help you adjust tomorrow's itinerary for you.' We had no choice but to have lunch at the airport restaurant, chatting while eating, which wasn't too boring after all.

While waiting, I browsed the bookstore wanting to buy some picture books about Yunnan's scenery. Mom was looking at silk scarves in the souvenir shop, saying she would give them to Grandma. Dad kept checking the weather forecast on his phone, hoping the rain would stop soon. Four hours was really long, and my legs went numb from sitting.

Finally, good news came over the broadcast: 'Dear passengers, boarding for the flight is now beginning.' We immediately picked up our luggage and walked quickly to the boarding gate. Mom checked her passport three times, afraid she had forgotten it. Dad laughed and said, 'You already checked it five times this morning, don't worry!'

After the plane took off, I looked through the window at the sea of clouds below, white like cotton. Although the delay was long, the scenery from the air was truly beautiful. Mom fell asleep on my shoulder; she had worked too hard preparing for this trip. Dad was reading a magazine, occasionally patting my hand.

When we arrived in Kunming, it was already dark. The tour guide was waiting for us at the exit holding a sign, and he helped us carry our luggage to the car. On the way to the hotel, he introduced that the ancient city we would visit tomorrow was very famous, where souvenirs were both cheap and distinctive. I was extremely happy, completely forgetting the unpleasantness of the delay.

This trip taught me that plans can never keep up with changes. Although the flight was delayed, our whole family was together, talking and laughing, which was also a special experience. Later we bought many beautiful souvenirs, took many photos, and controlled the budget very well. This was truly an unforgettable trip.

title: 德国室友的改变
body:
三年前，李明移民到德国柏林，为了提升口语能力，他特意选择了一位德国室友汉斯。起初，李明觉得汉斯很洋气，说话直接，做事干脆。但渐渐地，他发现汉斯身上有一种让他不舒服的个人主义。

汉斯经常把理论挂在嘴边，说什么"环保是每个人的实践"。可李明发现，汉斯从不垃圾分类，还怼那些提醒他的人。有一次，汉斯甚至说："污染是政府的事，我没理由操心。"这种双重标准让李明很难看。

更糟的是，汉斯喜欢发暴力表情包，还说这是幽默。李明试图反抗这种相处方式，但汉斯嘲笑他的阅读能力，说他不懂德国文化。李明感到自己在室友身边毫无地位，干脆搬了出去。

后来李明在新社区认识了老移民王阿姨。她告诉他："德国社会重视规则，但也有人把自由当借口。别让他们带来负面情绪。"如今李明明白了，真正的融入不是模仿，而是坚持自己的价值观。
translation: Three years ago, Li Ming emigrated to Berlin, Germany. To improve his speaking ability, he specially chose a German roommate named Hans. At first, Li Ming thought Hans was stylish and straightforward in speech and action. But gradually, he discovered that Hans had a kind of individualism that made him uncomfortable.

Hans often talked about theory, saying things like 'environmental protection is everyone's practice.' But Li Ming found that Hans never sorted his garbage and would talk back to those who reminded him. Once, Hans even said, 'Pollution is the government's business; I have no reason to worry about it.' This double standard made Li Ming feel ugly [about the situation].

What was worse was that Hans liked to send violent memes and said this was humor. Li Ming tried to resist this way of getting along, but Hans mocked his reading ability, saying he didn't understand German culture. Li Ming felt he had no status at his roommate's side and simply moved out.

Later, Li Ming met an old immigrant, Auntie Wang, in his new community. She told him, 'German society values rules, but some people use freedom as an excuse. Don't let them bring negative emotions.' Now Li Ming understands that real integration is not about imitation, but about holding on to one's own values.

title: 柏林的新生活
body:
李明是一位从北京移民到德国的中国青年。他特意选择在柏林定居，因为听说这里的环保实践很先进。然而，当他真正生活在这里后，发现身边的德国朋友虽然重视污染问题，却对个人主义有着近乎固执的坚持。

有一次，李明在地铁上看到一位老人被年轻人怼得说不出话，他忍不住上前理论，认为应该尊重长辈。德国朋友却告诉他，这里没有"必须让座"的规定，每个人都有反抗不合理要求的自由。李明觉得这种理由很荒唐，干脆发了个表情包表达无奈。

更让李明惊讶的是，一位曾因暴力犯罪入狱的土耳其移民，出狱后竟然获得了不错的社会地位。德国人说，监狱的目的是改造而非惩罚，只要真心改变，社会就会带来第二次机会。这种观念让李明觉得既洋气又难以理解。

一年后，李明的口语能力和阅读能力都有了很大提高。他不再觉得德国的社会规则难看，反而学会了在尊重个人自由的同时保持自己的文化特色。他终于明白，真正的融入不是放弃自我，而是找到两种文化的平衡点。
translation: Li Ming is a young Chinese man who immigrated to Germany from Beijing. He specially chose to settle in Berlin because he heard that environmental protection practices there are very advanced. However, after actually living there, he found that although his German friends around him took pollution seriously, they had an almost stubborn adherence to individualism.

Once, Li Ming saw an elderly person being talked back to by a young person on the subway until they couldn't speak, and he couldn't help stepping forward to argue that elders should be respected. His German friend told him that there was no rule "must give up seat" here, and everyone had the freedom to resist unreasonable demands. Li Ming found this reason absurd and simply sent a meme to express his helplessness.

What surprised Li Ming even more was that a Turkish immigrant who had been imprisoned for violent crimes actually obtained a decent social status after being released. Germans said that the purpose of prison was rehabilitation rather than punishment, and as long as one sincerely changed, society would bring a second chance. This concept made Li Ming find it both stylish and difficult to understand.

After one year, Li Ming's speaking ability and reading ability had greatly improved. He no longer found German social rules unsightly, but instead learned to maintain his own cultural characteristics while respecting individual freedom. He finally understood that true integration is not about abandoning oneself, but finding a balance between two cultures.

title: 柏林的新生活
body:
李明是一位从山东移民到德国的软件工程师。他特意选择柏林，因为听说这里的生活既洋气又包容。初到德国，他发现自己的口语能力还很弱，常常听不懂同事讲的本地笑话，连流行的表情包都看不懂。

在公司里，李明注意到德国社会非常重视个人主义。有一次，他的德国主管用很难看的脸色批评了一位实习生，理由只是对方在会议上"怼"了客户。李明起初不理解，后来才明白：在德国，直接表达意见是一种被尊重的实践，但用暴力语言或态度则会带来严重后果。

周末，李明参加了一个关于环境保护的读书会。大家讨论如何把理论变成实践，减少城市污染。一位老人分享了自己年轻时反抗东德政府、曾被关进监狱的经历。他说："我们那一代人争取的，就是让每个人身边都有发言的地位。"李明被深深打动，干脆报名参加了德语写作班，提升自己的阅读能力。

一年后，李明的德语进步很快。他不再觉得德国文化陌生，反而欣赏这种干脆直接的风格。他明白，真正的融入不是放弃自己的背景，而是理解不同社会如何平衡个人与集体的关系。
translation: Li Ming is a software engineer who immigrated to Germany from Shandong. He specially chose Berlin because he heard life here was both stylish and inclusive. Upon arriving in Germany, he discovered his speaking ability was still quite weak; he often couldn't understand the local jokes his colleagues told, and he couldn't even understand popular memes.

At the company, Li Ming noticed that German society places great importance on individualism. Once, his German supervisor criticized an intern with an extremely ugly expression, the reason being simply that the other person had 'talked back' to a client during a meeting. Li Ming didn't understand at first, but later realized: in Germany, expressing opinions directly is a respected practice, but using violent language or attitudes can bring serious consequences.

On the weekend, Li Ming attended a reading group about environmental protection. Everyone discussed how to turn theory into practice to reduce urban pollution. An elderly man shared his experience of resisting the East German government in his youth and being imprisoned. He said: 'What our generation fought for was to give everyone the status to speak their mind.' Li Ming was deeply moved and simply signed up for a German writing class to improve his reading ability.

A year later, Li Ming's German had improved rapidly. He no longer found German culture strange; instead, he appreciated this straightforward and direct style. He understood that true integration doesn't mean abandoning one's own background, but rather understanding how different societies balance the relationship between the individual and the collective.
